name: 披風英雄

style: simple flat vector illustration style with thick dark outlines and soft cel shading, like a children's picture book sticker, plain solid white background, no shadow, no text

surprised.text: Full body visible, standing with mouth wide open in shock, both hands on cheeks, eyes huge
